name: feishu-pro
description: 飞书通讯录与云文档工作台（**lark-cli 驱动**：凭证与接口交给官方 CLI，文档正文走 docs +fetch → markdown 富文本渲染；通讯录 / 会话 / 发送 / 私聊定位 / 私聊提醒也全部走 CLI；**自建凭证链（App 注册 / OAuth / token 续期）已删除**）：接入走 lark-cli 官方设备码（配置应用 / 登录账号都在浏览器完成，零手工 App ID）/ **会话列表（左列表 + 右消息视图：可读、可发文本、可一键加入监听；发送身份可切“我 / 机器人”，并检测缺哪些 scope）** / **会话内 AI 回复（右键某条消息 → 直接回复 = 生成即以当前身份发出，预览回复 = 先生成、正文可编辑后「发送这条」；锚定被右键的那条，提示词只看它及更早的消息、不调工具，直发失败不重试并自动转成预览草稿）** / **会话消息本地缓存（后台轮询与界面共用一份落盘缓存：选中会话秒开、只补增量、列表直接显示最后一条、支持本地关键词检索 `im_search`）** / **通讯录行内直接私聊或跳飞书** / 按关键词与部门查同事 / **最近访问**（按飞书身份分桶的本地记录：访问/创建/最后修改时间三显示，共用实例上互不可见）/ 我的空间（按修改或创建时间排序）/ 知识库（个人身份）/ 云文档搜索与阅读 / **消息同步与私聊提醒（同一个轮询引擎：私聊与群聊同一轮拉增量（从最新往回取一段，降序 3×50）、落本地缓存、首次静默建基线、自己发的不报、本地未读徽标；群消息默认自动同步进缓存、只同步不打扰；会话页顶部有同步状态条 + 「立即同步」，设置里有范围（私聊/群/手填）/ 间隔 / 通知开关与缓存自述）** / **open_id → 私聊 chat_id 解析（不发消息）** / 发送 scope 体检 / **会话读写（列会话 / 读最近消息 / 发文本：可切「我 / 机器人」身份，带幂等键）** / **私聊自动问答（可选开启：轮询新消息 → 跑一轮 agent → 以我/机器人身份回包，带白名单/冷却/限频/过期时效（面板可配），空跑模式可先只看不发）** / AI feishu_pro 工具。与原 feishu 插件完全独立 / **AI 待办（「待办」页签：本地待办库 + 飞书任务双向同步（新建可选同步飞书 / 编辑即 PATCH 回写）+ 后台定时自动同步与自动提取候选（默认关、15/30/60 分钟可选；来源是本地缓存的全部会话消息，不只监听名单）+ AI 逐条给处理建议 + 一键让 AI 自动处理；发送类动作先看草稿二次确认，其余直接执行）**
descriptionEn: Feishu contacts & cloud-doc workbench (lark-cli backed: credentials & APIs via the official CLI, docs rendered from +fetch markdown): onboarding via the official lark-cli device-code flow (no manual App ID), chat list (threaded read view, text sending as user or bot, one-click watch, right-click a message for on-demand AI replies — direct send, or preview that stays editable and is sent with one click; the reply is anchored to the clicked message, the prompt is self-contained over it and earlier messages and forbids tool calls, and a failed direct send is never retried but handed back as a preview draft, and a persistent local message cache shared by the background poller and the UI: instant chat opening, incremental refresh, last-message previews in the list, offline keyword search via im_search), contact search by keyword/department, doc search & reader, drive + wiki browsing, message sync & DM alerts on one poller (DMs and groups pulled in the same round, silent first baseline, strictly advancing watermark, never your own messages, group messages synced into the local cache by default without popping up; a sync strip with run-now on the chats tab and scope / interval / notify switches plus cache stats in settings), chat discovery, IM history reading and text sending (as the user or the bot, with idempotency keys), optional DM auto-reply (poll new messages, run one agent turn, answer as the user or bot; allowlist, cooldown, hourly cap, staleness window, all editable in settings, dry-run), and the feishu_pro AI tool. Fully independent from the original feishu plugin. / AI to-dos (a dedicated tab: a local to-do store with two-way Feishu Tasks sync (optional remote task on create, PATCH write-back on edit), an opt-in background job that periodically pulls Feishu tasks and extracts candidates from locally cached chat messages (any chat you opened or watch), per-item AI advice, one-click AI handling — outbound messages are shown as a draft for confirmation first)
